name: Roasted Delicata Squash (Tender Flesh Only, Skins Discarded)
whyItWorks: Sweet, custard-like winter squash roasted until meltingly tender. While healthy eaters often consume delicata skin, IBD patients should scoop out the interior flesh and discard the skin to prevent friction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Halve delicata squash, scoop out seeds, slice into half-moons, roast with olive oil and salt. Before eating, peel or fork away the thin skin.
